context.transcript:
Time to start planning the city's annual film festival.
Here's a list of tasks I've assigned to everyone.
I'll get in touch with vendors about concessions like food and souvenirs.
Jeff couldn't be here today, but I'll let him know what he'll be doing.
I'm also happy to say that the Reynold Movie Theater just finished its building renovations.
This is exciting because it now has more seats-which means we can have a seat-in-the-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back-back- We'll have many more festival attendees this year.
So, this year the first 200 attendees will get a free poster of one of the movies we'll be showing.
context.transcript_translation:
是时候开始规划城市一年一度的电影节了。
这是我分配给每个人的任务列表。
我会联系供应商，了解关于食物和纪念品等配套设施的情况。
Jeff 今天来不了，但我会告诉他他要做什么。
我也很高兴地宣布，Reynold 电影院刚刚完成了其建筑翻修。
这令人兴奋，因为它现在有更多的座位——这意味着我们今年会有更多影展参与者。
所以，今年前 200 名参与者将获得一张免费的、关于我们将要放映的电影的海报。
